Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Connected text and fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Connected text and fluency. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.
